entries.gave: Read the invoicer package as accounting meets it: the invoicer command, its help and refusals, and the lines, totals, tax and render modules it prints through.

Read N4 to N7 of the code best practice with their reasons and practices: tests that pass in any order on a fresh setup, one named test per case, tests through the interfaces only, and a failing test for any broken behavior.

Answered N4 and N6 in good: 66 tests pass on a fresh copy set up from pyproject.toml alone and in five shuffled orders, each through the public interfaces. N5 and N7 in more: 6 of 15 probe mutants survive, such as the unchecked negative amount limit, render ignoring its currency and a rate of 19%% accepted, and those cases have no named test.
Each of N4, N5, N6 and N7 is answered in answers-1.json; ending with done.
